verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs mention an analytics capability that 'tracks search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality and identify opportunities for improvement,' which covers query and click tracking, but no evidence explicitly documents a built-in dashboard for 'top queries' or 'no-result queries' reporting, nor any founder-facing UI for this data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of no-result query reporting, a top-queries view/dashboard, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that this analytics feature works as described.
